label: Lantas 1.5.1 development build
changes: Permissions: a proper approval card shows what Lantas will do, the details that matter and three choices — Decline, Allow once or Always allow. Always allow stops asking for that exact action and can be removed in Settings → Permissions.
Screen: Lantas asks macOS for Screen Recording itself, so it appears in the switch list instead of being missing. The screen card has Allow, Settings and Finder buttons and re-checks on its own.
Sign-in: a credential question opens one popup with username and password fields, over any chat, and stays put while you move between tabs.
Chat: thinking is grouped with the steps it explains, so a long turn is one collapsed line with a duration and step count instead of a column of Thought rows.
Storage: the browser mirror keeps a trimmed recent copy instead of every session, so the storage-full warning stops appearing.
